preconditions.description: Contract must have accumulated fees (balanceOf(address(this)) >= swapTokensAtAmount)
Attacker must hold some Honey tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in swapAndLiquify() function at line 578 where denominator calculation can cause precision loss. When (temp.liquidity + temp.marketing + temp.Stake + temp.Dapp) * 2 results in a small denominator (e.g., 0 or 1), division operations will fail or produce incorrect results. Set taxes to create a denominator of 0 or 1 using setTaxes() or setSellTaxes() as owner, then trigger swapAndLiquify by transferring tokens to accumulate fees and cause a swap. This can lead to incorrect BNB distribution, potentially allowing attacker to receive more BNB than intended.
